snapshotPolicy.purpose: Provide a common, closed component-design space for benchmark comparison while retaining freedom in architecture and custom structural design.
snapshotPolicy.catalogueNature: Frozen neutral benchmark catalogue. MTR-075 is a public manufacturer-data crosswalk; the other neutral classes are benchmark-design-basis equivalents representing adjacent industrial ranges. The catalogue is not a purchasing specification or manufacturer warranty.
snapshotPolicy.candidateUse: Closed-source policy: every purchased motor, reducer, brake, bearing, and gripper transmission that appears in the CAD/BOM or supports a load, safety, life, clearance, service, mass, inertia, or performance claim shall be one of the supported IDs in this snapshot and shall use its matching frozen interface card. Unlisted purchased components in those classes are prohibited. Candidate-designed fabricated structures, adapters, couplings, fingers, and compliant pads remain permitted, but their properties are candidate evidence rather than catalogue substitutions. Generic consumables that carry no claimed load may be listed as no-credit consumables.
snapshotPolicy.units: SI; dimensional values in mm; torque in N·m; mass in kg.

evaluationClasses.supported: Automatic range, ratio, mass, and rating checks are available within the declared benchmark catalogue scope.
evaluationClasses.declarable-manual: Not available in this packet. It is retained only as a framework vocabulary label; no candidate component may use this class.
evaluationClasses.prohibited: Item cannot be used in the submitted candidate design.

servoMotors.valueProvenance: Manufacturer-public-data-equivalent: Yaskawa Sigma-7 SGM7A 750 W public table (REF-YASKAWA-SGM7A). Rotor inertia and mass are neutral benchmark values because the task evaluates system design rather than a named SKU.
servoMotors.applicability: Supported motor class for automatic range checks in v1.0.
servoMotors.uncertainty: Torque and speed use the public table; neutral inertia and mass retain ±10% modelling uncertainty.

servoMotors.valueProvenance: Benchmark-design-basis neutral servo class, interpolated around published industrial servo data-sheet ranges.

servoMotors.uncertainty: ±10% rating, inertia, and mass modelling uncertainty; no physical test has been performed.
